title: Structure of an indecomposable injective module
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement describes the structure of an indecomposable injective module: it is the injective hull of each nonzero submodule, nonzero submodules meet, its endomorphism ring is local with the non-injective endomorphisms as the maximal ideal, and the zerodivisors on it form a prime ideal over which it stays injective (author lemma at source lines 774-786, label lemma-indecomposable-injective). The proof (source lines 788-811) uses uniqueness of injective hulls for the first two assertions and runs the local-ring argument for the third, ending with the prime ideal and the injectivity over the localisation (proof lines 788-810). The local endomorphism ring argument is the substance. H3.
